title: Acquirer: Accord Cutomer Care Solutions (ACCS); Target: MobilefoneRepaircom (MfR)

body_sections.Summary: Both MobilefoneRepair.com (MfR) and Accord Customer Care Solutions (ACCS) operate in what is generally described as the after-market service (AMS) industry for mobile phones. AMS covers a variety of services such as repair and servicing along with warranty management, customer support, call management and parts distribution management. ACCS proposes to acquire MfR.com
body_sections.Market definition: This merger was assessed in the market for after-market service for mobile phones.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission concluded that while the merged entity appears to maintain a significant market share of the AMS market for mobile phones, particularly for warranty repairs, barriers to entry appear to be low and mobile phone manufacturers have a significant degree of countervailing power which is likely to act as a constraint on prices for after market service.
